Behavior & Comms Score 3.0: Definitive Overhaul Blueprint
22 Oct @ 3:22am
Azure
Originally posted by sky3tone:
The most absurd thing about the Behavior Score system is that a first-time Dota player can get reported by their entire team for playing poorly—without having uttered a single word—and end up losing microphone.

If match telemetry records positive performance metrics (high combat activity, hero damage, or proactive support impact), the system flags incoming "Griefing" reports as statistically invalid. Furthermore, zero telemetry anomalies guarantee a baseline behavior score increment, completely bypassing unverified user inputs

Section 3 (Fair Filtering & Automation Control): Implements deterministic logging and anti-bullying heuristics.
